messages:
Maya: quick UX check — on mobile portrait (<=420px) the console's right-side details panel overlaps the Instances table and we get horizontal scroll. Can we collapse to full-width table and move details into a bottom sheet/drawer on narrow screens?

Jon: yep reproduced on iPhone 12 mini. Repro steps: Console > Deployments > Instances, rotate to portrait. Header gets clipped and there's a horizontal scrollbar.

Priya: is this the same cluster as earlier table-card stacking? Feels different since the sidebar stays visible. Looks like a breakpoint mismatch — sidebar collapses at 600px but table layout expects 480px.

Alex: confirmed. We currently have two breakpoints: --bp-table: 480px and --bp-sidebar: 600px. Suggest we unify to a single mobile breakpoint (520px?) and switch to drawer/bottom-sheet behavior for <=520px.

Sam: accessibility note — if we put details into a bottom sheet, ensure focus trap, aria-modal, and keyboard dismiss. Also touch targets must stay >=44px and provide a skip link to jump back to the table rows.

Maya: also small copy tweak: change the compact "Details" button label to "View details" so screen readers announce intent more clearly.

Priya: I can prototype both options. Quick CSS fallback for internal table scroll if we need a quick patch: 
```css
.table-container { overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; }
.table { min-width: 720px; }
```

Jon: I'd rather avoid horizontal scrolling on phones when possible — bottom sheet is generally better for discoverability and avoids cramped rows.

DesignBot: New design task created: DES-3482 — mobile table + sidebar behavior. https://redwood.design/tasks/DES-3482

Maya: Can we A/B test bottom sheet vs internal horizontal scroll? Metric ideas: time-to-details-click, number of accidental horizontal swipes that trigger navigator back, and task completion for quick edits.

Alex: yep add those metrics. Also check animation performance — drawer should not block JS main thread; use composited transforms for translateY.

Priya: I'll put both mocks in Figma and include an a11y checklist + touch-target overlays. ETA tomorrow EOD.

Sam: small color/accessibility nit — header icon color (#6b7280) is borderline on the current header background and fails AA in some states. Recommend #4b5563 or bump weight.

Maya: thanks — assigning to Priya; engineering to pick up after mocks. I'll add DES-3482 to milestone 3.2. :thumbsup:

Jon: LGTM. I'll follow up on console runtime changes to ensure drawer gesture doesn't conflict with native back-swipe on iOS.

Priya: uploaded Figma prototypes: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/mobile-table-sidebar-proto — added notes and keyboard flow.

DesignBot: Reminder: please attach accessibility checklist (WCAG, touch targets, focus order) to the design task before final sign-off.
